title: Paper v2 auto-creates manifest minute policy as BACKTEST_VALIDATED execution policy without explicit evidence
description:
Expected: ValidatedExecutionPolicy records should be created from explicit backtest or simulation evidence and should not be automatically synthesized from StrategyPackage manifest runtime fields. A policy can be activated for Paper/MiniQMT only when policy_json, source_backtest_id, validation evidence, validation_status, and paper_enabled have been explicitly reviewed and persisted. The initial QE execution config may be imported as evidence only when the source artifact proves the backtest succeeded with that exact policy.
Actual: PaperTradingV2PortfolioService._ensure_default_manifest_execution_policy normalizes manifest.minute_execution_policy, creates manifest_default_execution_policy when no policy exists, and sets source_backtest_status='BACKTEST_VALIDATED' with paper_enabled=True. This reinforces manifest-bound execution policy and may create a validated policy without a durable proof object beyond the package source id.
required_verification: Creating a paper portfolio without an explicit validated execution policy no longer auto-synthesizes BACKTEST_VALIDATED evidence unless a durable source proof is available.
Tests still reject raw paper-only execution overrides and unknown fallback algos.
Runs persist the validated policy id/hash/json and source evidence used.
closure_requirements: ValidatedExecutionPolicy creation requires explicit evidence or a verified import path.
Manifest minute policy is not treated as automatic paper-approved execution authority.
